plainTranslation: Their Neptune in your 8th house: dreamy, dissolving intimacy - spiritual or sexual merging that blurs boundaries. Failure mode: deception or self-deception around sex and money, losing yourself in the bond. Let the closeness be deep; stay clear about boundaries and shared resources.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
